column4: toolchain-gated: this job sets up Go and (conditionally) Rust and no Python at all, so cleat_sdk cannot be imported and runVetPython returns vetExitUnmeasured for every input. The arm is a FLOOR for the two UNMEASURED arms beside it -- it asserts a real violation still comes back as a finding, which is what stops those arms from passing against a checker that had stopped discriminating entirely. With no interpreter that distinction cannot be drawn, so the arm skips rather than fails: it is a precondition of the test, not a verdict about the tree. It RUNS wherever the SDK is importable, including test-python (3.10/3.11/3.12) and locally.
